name: snapland
description: Snapland: real-time collaborative GIS (Fastify + PostGIS + Redis + React/Leaflet)

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @snapland/shared && npm run e2e -w @snapland/e2e
scripts.build: npm run build -w @snapland/shared && npm run build -w @snapland/backend && npm run build -w @snapland/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run check:deps
